Its owning dispatch, 42049519894 (tzap 0.1.2), completed as failure at 2026-11-06T18:40:19Z, and no record says which shards failed or were cancelled. The last record says core-3 (svg-geometry, 352 mutants) still hit the 60-minute limit on 0.1.2. So the bump alone cannot meet the row's 'previously cancelled shards finishing within the 60-minute limit under 0.1.2', and the row's other route, re-partitioning them, has not been started. Meanwhile scheduled nightly 42195174441 at c0993e0, on tzap 0.1.1, has been queued since 09:27:21Z and now holds nightly.yml's group. On the evidence of 41806720128 and 42003285284, it will run for hours and cancel the same shards. No record names it.

findings.summary: M18.157 attempt 4's shared packing in the ladder has no harness case. packOnce and packageCheck make publint and attw await one --pack-to run, pass --tarballs, and remove the folder after the ladder. packages.test covers check-packages' flags only. No case shows that the ladder packs once, that both steps read the shared folder, that a failed pack fails both steps, or that the folder is removed. The code fails safe: a missing tarball or a failed pack is a failure, not a pass. The gap is in time accounting and cleanup, not in gate honesty.

questions.coherence: Coherent, and the Windows work has settled. M18.282 dropped --with-deps from the last Windows installs on the recorded evidence, and three green runs read 1-2 s. M18.285 is a narrow, well-argued exclusion: the browser start is marked just before the first session, and a unit case pins that nothing input-driven falls inside it. M18.157 attempt 4 removes duplicated CPU (a second packing, 43 redundant compiler programs) and does not cut any check. The weak part is M18.10, which moved backwards: its dispatch failed, and a 0.1.1 nightly holds the group (F1).
questions.specFidelity: No FR or NFR text changed. ADR-0217 narrows ADR-0206's 10 s refusal bound to exclude the first witness session's browser start. ADR-0206's Confirmation and M18.229's row point to it, and NFR-SEC-001's own text has no time bound, so no requirement edit was needed. ADR-0216 is unchanged, and attempt 4 changes no part of NFR-DX-001's measure. M18.236 met its acceptance as amended. The amendment dropped M18.10 in the closing commit, under the delegation, and it is logged and reasoned: the spec held only design that ADR-0173/ADR-0198 and testing.md carry. But its purpose clause ('so the leg passes') is still unmet because of M18.157's folder (F3). M18.245, M18.282, M18.284 and M18.285 each meet their acceptance cells.
questions.standardsDrift: Two drifts. blockedReason went stale within the commit that wrote it (F2, the ninth checkpoint in a row). One commit body names a pre-land sha (F5). Otherwise the conventions held: Fixes-ci and Removes-test trailers, every review round in the digest (M18.282 r1-r2, M18.285 r1, M18.284 r1 plan, M18.236 r1-r2, M18.157 r1), argued lines for each argued review finding, and Commit cells naming landed commits of their own rows. M18.245's cell names 26f5138, an earlier M18.245 commit, rather than the closing e1e9666; that is valid under M18.207.
questions.gateHonesty: No gate was weakened. No change touches thresholds.mjs, and COLD_SETUP_MAX_MS is still 600 s. publint still runs with strict, now through its API on the same pnpm-pack tarball that its CLI would have built. attw keeps --profile esm-only. Both still cover all 32 libraries in --all. check-api compares every one of the 44 reports. M18.285 keeps the 10 s bound and every exit, message and empty-output assertion. A start that fails without witness-ready makes the subtraction NaN, so the bound fails. Mutant spot-checks by reading: (1) if packageCheck ignored a failed pack's status, the tarball lookup would still throw 'expected one tarball', which packages.test's 'none' case pins; (2) if pack-import marked witness-start after importSvgBatch began, the unit case's slice ['witness-start','session','witness-ready'] would fail; (3) if visual-xos regained --with-deps on Windows, ci-workflow.test's [1, 3] would fail. The completion gate cannot go green with 3 open rows, the mutation evidence and the final review missing.
questions.architecture: Clean. The only package source changed is packages/cli/src/pack-import.ts (one phase mark and its type), and it stays outside the pure core. The new harness code uses already-installed tools (publint's API, API Extractor's CompilerState) and adds no dependency. ADR-0217 is used, and the next free ADR is 0218.
